transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I guess… I just can’t really make myself do anything anymore. I mostly sit in my room, wearing the same clothes, and I don’t do the things I used to like, like knitting or journaling or going on walks. When my mom asks me what’s wrong, I barely even have the energy to answer her.
Have you been feeling sad or down most of the time?
I don’t know if I’d call it sad exactly. I just feel… kind of empty, or tired. Down sometimes, yeah, but mostly I don’t feel much.
Have you been feeling this empty and unable to do things nearly every day for at least two weeks?
Yeah… definitely longer than two weeks. It’s been going on since I started the community college program, so about two years and a couple months now.
During these past two years, was there ever a stretch of two months or longer when you felt mostly back to your usual self?
No… I don’t think so. It’s kind of just been steady since I started community college, like two years and a couple months ago. I haven’t really had a couple months where I felt normal again.
Did these feelings start after a specific stressful event?
Not really. I can’t think of one specific thing that happened. It just kind of started around that time and stayed.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is around?
I’m not sure… I mean, I don’t think so. I haven’t really noticed hearing actual voices when nobody’s there.
During this time, have you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?
I don’t know… I haven’t really thought of it as being depressed most of the day. I’ve felt off a lot, but I’m not sure it’s that exactly.
Over the past two years, have you felt down or depressed more days than not?
I’m not really sure. I’ve had a lot of times where I felt off or not like myself, but I don’t know if I’d say I was depressed more days than not for two years.
Have you been feeling bad about yourself?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I’ve been sitting there thinking badly about myself all the time, but I haven’t felt great either.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in the things you used to enjoy, like knitting, journaling, or going on walks?

Yeah… I pretty much stopped doing those things. I don’t knit or write in my journal anymore, and I don’t really go on walks. Mostly I just sit in my room, sometimes in the same clothes, and I can’t make myself do anything. When my mom asks me what’s wrong, I barely even have the energy to answer her.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?
I’m not sure. I don’t really pay attention to that, I guess. Sometimes I can’t stick with things, but I don’t know if it’s concentration exactly.
Over the past two years, have you felt sad or depressed most days?
I don’t really know. I haven’t been keeping track like that. I know I haven’t felt good a lot, but I can’t say if it’s been most days for two years.
Do you often feel anxious or worried?
I don’t really know. I mean, I get uneasy sometimes, but I haven’t paid enough attention to say if I’m anxious a lot or worried all the time.
Do you spend a lot of time worrying?
I don’t know. I don’t really think of it as worrying a lot. Sometimes my mind gets stuck on things, but I’m not sure if that’s what you mean.
Have other people told you that your face or voice seems flat or shows very little emotion?

Yeah… my mom has said I seem kind of blank. Like she’ll ask what’s wrong and I barely answer, and I don’t really show much. Mostly I just sit in my room in the same clothes and can’t make myself do anything anymore.
Do you feel like you want to do things but can’t get yourself started?

Yeah. I want to do things, or I think I do, but I just can’t start. I mostly sit in my room in the same clothes. I don’t knit or journal or go walking like I used to. Even when my mom asks what’s wrong, I barely have the energy to answer.
Do you have beliefs that other people would find strange or hard to believe, and that you feel sure are true?

Yeah… I mean, I know people think it sounds strange. But since I was in those college classes, I’ve been sure the school portal and the clinic practicum people were using little wording changes in emails and assignment comments to mark me. Like, to show I’m someone they don’t want in healthcare. My mom says they’re just normal messages, but it doesn’t feel that way to me.
How long have you been convinced that the school portal and practicum people were marking you through those wording changes?
About two months now. That’s when it really became fixed in my mind, like I was sure the wording changes meant they were marking me.
In the past two months, have you heard voices talking to you or about you when no one was actually there?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t heard voices when nobody was there, at least not that I can remember.
When you became convinced that the wording changes were marking you, were you feeling depressed at that time?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I was stressed and upset about it, but I don’t know if I’d call it depressed. I didn’t really think about it that way at the time.

final_diagnosis.reason: The interview most strongly supports a schizophrenia-spectrum disorder, coded here as schizophrenia, unspecified (F20.9), because the patient reports a fixed persecutory/delusion-like belief lasting about two months along with prominent negative symptoms including avolition, markedly reduced emotional expression, low energy, social/behavioral withdrawal, and loss of interest. Depressive disorders were considered because of chronic emptiness, low energy, and anhedonia, but the patient did not clearly endorse depressed mood most days, and the psychotic belief is not well accounted for by the available mood history. Anxiety/depression mixed state was not supported due to insufficient anxiety symptoms.
